title: Kimi K3 Is Not Cheap
excerpt: The new Chinese LLM is not what (some) people think.
content_html:
The new Chinese LLM is not what (some) people think.

Kimi K3, the new open-weights LLM from Chinese lab Moonshot AI, dropped last week. It’s a powerful model that, perhaps inevitably, sparked debate — including accusations of ushering in decelerationist ‘AI communism’ (whatever that means).

Amidst the noise, a number of AI commentators (including the Hard Fork guys and Scott Galloway) have asserted that K3 is noteworthy because it’s nearly as good as US models, at a fraction of the cost.

Unfortunately, they are wrong. Just because a model is Chinese, it is not magically cheap. And in fact, K3 isn’t cheap. Across Artificial Analysis’s ‘Intelligence Index’ benchmark, it cost slightly less per task than OpenAI’s top model. Compared to other Chinese models, it’s positively expensive - double the cost of GLM-5.2, and ~20x more than DeepSeek V4.

There’s nuance, of course. Kimi costs less for coding, but more for office work. It’s verbose, so it takes longer to solve problems. It’s open-weights, so you could (with a few GPUs) finetune it for your own purposes. But we’re not talking nuance here, this is just about one claim that I’ve seen/heard enough to find slightly annoying.

In summary: Is K3 a big step forwards for Chinese LLMs (and the open-weights people)? Yes. Is it concerning for the US market that a Chinese lab have fast-followed OpenAI and Anthropic with much less capex, possibly aided by distillation? Also yes. Is it cheap? No. No it isn’t. Please stop saying that. And please stop saying it’s another ‘DeepSeek moment’ too.

Posted on July 26, 2026

content_html_zh:
新的中国LLM并不是（某些）人想象的那样。

来自中国 Moonshot AI 实验室的新开放权重法学硕士 Kimi K3 上周被放弃。 这是一个强大的模型，也许不可避免地引发了争论——包括引入减速主义“人工智能共产主义”（无论这意味着什么）的指控。

在喧嚣声中，许多人工智能评论员（包括硬分叉专家和斯科特·加洛韦）断言 K3 值得注意，因为它几乎与美国模型一样好，而成本只是美国模型的一小部分。

不幸的是，他们错了。 仅仅因为一个模型是中国的，它并不神奇地便宜。 事实上，K3并不便宜。 在 Artificial Analysis 的“智能指数”基准测试中，每项任务的成本比 OpenAI 的顶级模型略低。 与其他中国型号相比，它的价格非常昂贵——是 GLM-5.2 成本的两倍，比 DeepSeek V4 高出约 20 倍。

当然，这其中存在细微差别。 Kimi 的编码成本较低，但办公室工作成本较高。 它很冗长，因此解决问题需要更长的时间。 它是开放权重的，因此您可以（使用一些 GPU）根据自己的目的对其进行微调。 但我们在这里讨论的不是细微差别，这只是我所看到/听到的足以让我觉得有点烦人的一种说法。

总结：对于中国法学硕士（以及开放权重人士）来说，K3 是否向前迈出了一大步？ 是的。 对于美国市场来说，中国实验室快速追随 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 且资本支出少得多（可能需要蒸馏的帮助），这是否令人担忧？ 也是的。 便宜吗？ 不，不，不是。 请别再这么说了。 请不要再说这又是一个“DeepSeek 时刻”。

发表于 2026 年 7 月 26 日
